create_Plot_class: create a Plot instance with metrics list, title, and axis labels for real-time visdom plotting
update_Plot_metric: update a Plot metric with x and y values to append data to the visdom line chart
create_ModulePlot_class: create a ModulePlot instance for a PyTorch module to track weight and gradient norms
update_ModulePlot: update a ModulePlot at step x to plot current weight and gradient norms across all submodules
review_Plot_update_metric: review the Plot _update_metric method that computes a running average over a fixed window size
